payload.prompt:
Run `git diff` in the working directory and review the uncommitted changes to console.py, railway/server.py, and web/js/api.js.

Goal of the change: allow new "observation lesson" file pairs like tex/L35_P2_obs_{student,teacher}.tex to flow through the local Flask Teacher Console (console.py), the Vercel-hosted web app (web/js/api.js), and the Railway pdflatex build service (railway/server.py), without breaking existing L{NN}_P{N} lessons. The supabase seed (supabase/seed.py) was intentionally NOT modified — its existing tex glob already produces a lessons-table row with id "L35_P2_obs" automatically.

Verify:
1. Regexes accept BOTH the old shape (L41_P2) AND the new shape (L35_P2_obs) and reject obvious garbage (APStats_*, raw "3-5", path traversal etc.).
2. itemsForLesson stripping logic in web/js/api.js handles edge cases: APStats ids, raw "3-5", null/empty input.
3. Pacer-link extraction in console.py still produces L35_Pacer.html for both L35_P2 and L35_P2_obs.
4. No silent regressions in routes that take lesson_id (railway server tex PUT, build POST). Inspect railway/server.py routes.
5. Title display for _obs in the console — does it look reasonable when the underlying yaml lacks a title?

If you find a bug, fix it directly via patch. If everything looks correct, return a SHORT confirmation. Do NOT commit. Do NOT run pdflatex. Do NOT run seed scripts. Do NOT modify any tex files. Keep response under 250 words plus any patches.
